questions.question: How has the evidence of poverty shifted over the past forty years in United States?

options.text: It has shifted from the southern plantation areas to the hills of the rural Appalachian Plateau.
It has shifted from affecting the rural poor to affecting the middle-income groups
It has shifted from rural areas to urban areas.
It has shifted from the low developed countries to those which are highly developed.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is ‘**It has shifted from rural areas to urban areas.**’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about the viewpoint of an author regarding economics and social development in different countries of the world as presented in a book written by him. 
 
• According to the passage, the author noted that the evidence of poverty has shifted over the past forty years. 
 
• While before it was ‘.*..the problem of southern plantation agriculture and the hills and hollows of the rural Appalachian Plateau.*’ Now it is’* ... the highly visible problem of the great metropolis*.’ 
 
• **Metropolis **means **the capital or chief city of a country or region; a very large and busy city.**
 
• Thus, the evidence of poverty has **shifted from rural areas to urban areas.** 
 
• Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which emotion best describes the author’s attitude when he was asked regarding the latter-day relevance of his book?

options.text: Intolerable
Blithe
Grim
Doleful

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'blithe'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage, when the author of the book was asked regarding its latter-day relevance,** he happily responded although he thought that such a question should not be put to any author.** (*The book had a satisfying reception, and I’m here asked as to its latter-day relevance. That should not be asked of any author, but the mistake having been made, I happily respond.*) 
 
• **Blithe **means to exhibit a casual and cheerful indifference. 
 
• Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of the other options are as follows – 

 
 
• **Intolerable **- unable to be endured. 
 
• **Grim **- very serious or gloomy. 
 
• **Doleful **- expressing sorrow; mournful.

questions.question: What would the author have emphasized on if he wrote his books in the present times?

options.text: He would have emphasized the disparity in well-being between the developed and under-developed countries.
He would have emphasized the economical well-being in the developed nations of the world.
He would have emphasized the social well-being in developing countries of the world after their post-colonial period.
He would have emphasized the economic disparity between the developed and the under-developed countries.

questions.solution:

questions.question: What does the author mean when he states – ‘the progress has not kept pace with the rhetoric.’

options.text: People only give speeches but will never help the poor.
Politicians refuse to acknowledge the income disparity between countries.
The steps taken to address the disparity between the countries are not adequate.
The evident disparity between countries is not being addressed properly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **‘****The steps taken to address the disparity between the countries are not adequate.’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us analyze the quoted statement. 
 
• The author makes it at the end of the passage after talking about how there is a developing concern regarding the disparity between rich and poor nations. 
 
• Now **rhetoric** means the art of effective or persuasive speaking or writing, especially the exploitation of figures of speech and other compositional techniques. 
 
• Thus, according to the author, although there are steps being taken to address the rising concern, it is not at par with what is being said or talked about. 
 
• This makes **option 3** the correct answer.
